senses.gloss: m. (= תָּאוָן; v. תָּא I, a. תְּוָא I) cell, chamber.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 22:25">Targ. I Kings XXII, 25</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 18:24">Targ. II Chr. XVIII, 24</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תְּוָונַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="V00182"><he>תְּוָונֵי</he></cite>, <he>תְּוָנ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:33">Targ. Job XXXI, 33</cite> <he>תווני לבי</he> Ms. Var. (h. text <he>חֻבִּי</he>, v. <cite ref="P00174"><he>עוּבָּא</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Niddah 20b:32">Nidd. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>יהודאי בת׳ לבאי יתביתו</he> Rashi (ed. <he>בת׳ דלבא</he>) you Jews seem to sit in the inner chambers of men’s hearts (of the heart).
